description: Pursuant to the provisions of H.Res. 707, the amendment in the nature of a substitute consisting of the text of Rules Committee Print 119-12 is adopted.
latestAction: On agreeing to the Rules amendment (A001) Agreed to without objection.
amendedBillTitle: To lower the age at which a minor may be tried as an adult for certain criminal offenses in the District of Columbia to 14 years of age.
